name: chatgpt-local-bridge
description: Control the user's own Windows PC and local development workspaces directly from normal ChatGPT requests.

interface.shortDescription: Execute normal-language requests directly on this Windows PC, including GUI actions and Paint drawing.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Local Bridge exposes bounded local Windows and workspace actions to ChatGPT Desktop. When a request explicitly targets this PC, the assistant should perform it through the bridge rather than merely describing or simulating it in chat. For Paint drawing requests, the bridge provides a high-level draw_in_paint action so the assistant can generate a self-contained SVG and render it directly into Microsoft Paint. Users speak normally and never need to name tools.
defaultPrompt: Open Paint and draw Satoru Gojo on my PC
Work on DoOnce and verify the change
Open an installed app on my PC
